scope.quantification: Complete paired quantification including index loading, every pair, fragment estimation, EM, full default TSV/HDF5 output and shutdown; retrieval/trimming excluded.

scope.rust_timing: Optional timing enabled for all Rust tools. Released download lacks phase boundaries; those stage times are not inferred.
scope.phase_statistics: Independent stage medians may not sum to the whole-process median.
scope.cpu_contention: All observations retained; sampled external CPU activity flagged per run.
scope.reported_index_stages: Current stages do not overlap. v0.5.0 write includes MPHF work also in minimizer_mphf; its raw reported stages must not be added.
scope.schedule: Every current measurement uses the fixed source binary. Large cDNA control medians retain the unchanged three-tool session observations, with fresh original rechecks. TT-seq has a fresh rotated three-tool series. The small current/original one-thread and four-tool eight-thread controls were refreshed after detecting timing drift; earlier legacy one-thread controls are not used for published comparisons. Small original rechecks are also the first refreshed original observations.
scope.source_consistency: All current timings, EC checks, native output checks and index compatibility checks use the corrected 0.5.1 source binary identified by its hash.
